articles.title: A Systematic Review of New, Enhanced Surveillance Systems and Methodologies for Zoonotic Influenza Viruses in Animals and Human-Animal Interface.

diseases.name_zh: 人感染高致病性禽流感

en.research_question: The authors aimed to evaluate recent developments in monitoring techniques for animal and cross-species influenza viruses to determine which innovations warrant broader application and which areas require further investigation.
en.study_design: This work follows a systematic review framework guided by PRISMA standards, synthesizing data from 164 selected publications out of an initial search yielding 7,490 records.
en.population_setting: The scope encompasses global efforts to track influenza strains circulating among wildlife, livestock, and humans, with particular attention to interaction zones where spillover events occur.
en.main_findings: The analysis identifies multiple technological improvements alongside persistent structural deficiencies in monitoring networks. Current documentation indicates that numerous regions operate without robust cross-sectoral tracking systems, resulting in incomplete estimates of infection prevalence. Priority actions emphasize integrating multi-sectoral datasets, standardizing new testing tools, scaling passive sampling strategies, and aligning technical upgrades with regulatory decision-making.
en.public_health_relevance: Strengthening coordinated monitoring frameworks is presented as essential for reducing seasonal illness impacts and mitigating future outbreak threats through improved diagnostic readiness and targeted research funding.
en.limitations: The evaluation relies exclusively on indexed academic publications, which may overlook operational field data or reflect uneven research investment across different geographic areas. Additionally, the focus on a seven-year window restricts historical context for long-term trend analysis.
en.gids_interpretation: This publication offers a consolidated perspective on methodological evolution within cross-species pathogen tracking initiatives. It contextualizes recent scholarly contributions toward standardized data collection and policy alignment without referencing active epidemiological dashboards or real-time transmission metrics.

articles.title: When should a public health emergency of international concern be declared? The case of the 2018–2020 Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo

en.research_question: What factors influenced the timing and rationale behind declaring an international health emergency during the 2018–2020 DRC Ebola response?
en.study_design: A retrospective examination utilizing archival document review and interviews with previous committee participants.
en.population_setting: Former members of the World Health Organization Emergency Committee who participated in evaluating the North Kivu and Ituri Ebola crisis.
en.main_findings: Internal deliberations prioritized local political conditions, institutional reputation management, and anticipated travel or community restrictions over standardized regulatory thresholds. Decision-making processes remained heavily influenced by established global security paradigms that frame specific outbreaks as transnational threats.
en.public_health_relevance: Understanding these procedural influences helps clarify potential gaps between formal guidelines and actual emergency classification practices, which may impact future policy adjustments and institutional trust.
en.limitations: Reliance on retrospective self-reported accounts and historical documents may compromise the accuracy of reconstructed decision timelines and internal reasoning.
en.gids_interpretation: This work situates international emergency declarations within broader policy and administrative contexts, providing background reference material for tracking how global health alert systems evolve through scholarly and institutional discourse.

articles.title: Tick-borne encephalitis vaccination coverage among outdoor workers in Sweden: a nationwide survey

related_surveillance.method: high-confidence article geography intersected with GIDS series coverage

zh.research_question: 瑞典户外职业人群对蜱传脑炎的疫苗接种覆盖率及其相关知识、态度与行为现状如何？
zh.study_design: 该研究采用全国性横断面调查设计，于二零二四年收集数据以评估目标人群的免疫实践状况。
zh.population_setting: 研究对象为瑞典从事农业、林业、狩猎、科研及自然导览等户外作业成年人员。
zh.main_findings: 受访者对疫苗的认知与态度整体处于中等偏上水平，但实际接种率未能同步提升且存在显著差异。女性群体及南部和中部地区居民的参与比例较高，约七成报告已完成至少三剂接种，但部分细分人群中仍存在未接种现象。
zh.public_health_relevance: 尽管高危职业群体具备一定疾病防范意识，但免疫屏障尚未完全建立，提示需通过定向干预与政策优化来缩小接种缺口。
zh.limitations: 作为基于单一时间点的横断面自我报告调查，该设计难以确立变量间的时序关系，且可能受到回忆偏差的影响。
zh.gids_interpretation: 本文提供了瑞典特定职业暴露背景下的免疫模式基线信息，可作为区域健康监测框架的背景参考，不涉及实时疫情信号关联。

en.research_question: The investigation aimed to quantify tick-borne encephalitis immunization rates among Swedish individuals employed in outdoor occupations, addressing a documented gap in existing epidemiological data.
en.study_design: Researchers utilized a nationwide cross-sectional survey methodology to collect self-reported knowledge, attitudes, and practice data during 2024.
en.population_setting: The analytical sample comprised 1006 consenting adults working in outdoor sectors such as agriculture, forestry, hunting, scientific research, and wildlife guiding across Sweden.
en.main_findings: Participants exhibited moderate awareness and positive views regarding immunization, yet actual uptake rates fell short of these metrics and differed markedly across demographics. Female respondents achieved higher assessment scores and vaccination rates than males, while geographic analysis revealed superior coverage in southern and central counties relative to northern areas. Roughly seventy percent indicated completion of a three-dose regimen, although distinct demographic clusters remained largely unprotected.
en.public_health_relevance: Rising regional disease incidence contrasts with the exclusion of the prophylactic agent from official immunization schedules, highlighting the need for occupational-specific interventions and financial support mechanisms to mitigate transmission risk.
en.limitations: The cross-sectional framework restricts temporal analysis of behavioral shifts, and reliance on self-reported immunization records introduces potential recall inaccuracies.
en.gids_interpretation: This publication establishes a descriptive baseline for occupational immunization patterns, offering contextual reference points for literature mapping and regional health strategy discussions without implying real-time outbreak tracking.

articles.title: Streptococcus Pyogenes and Acute Rheumatic Fever: How Strong are the Links in the Chain?

en.research_question: The authors evaluate the historical and contemporary scientific basis connecting group A streptococcal infections to acute rheumatic fever and subsequent cardiac complications. They assess how well established epidemiological and biological frameworks explain this relationship.
en.study_design: This publication operates as a narrative review that aggregates and evaluates literature spanning approximately two hundred years. It applies standardized causality assessment tools and evidence grading systems to synthesize past and recent publications.
en.population_setting: The analysis references data collected across various global regions and demographic groups. However, the authors explicitly identify a shortage of modern cohort studies focusing on vulnerable communities.
en.main_findings: Unmanaged bacterial infections correspond with elevated rheumatic fever rates, whereas antimicrobial therapy lowers these occurrences. The chronological progression from microbial exposure to clinical onset receives moderate validation, alongside claims about pathogen specificity. Proposed immunological explanations remain plausible but lack robust empirical confirmation. Significant uncertainties persist regarding contemporary trial requirements and cutaneous transmission pathways.
en.public_health_relevance: The synthesized information supports ongoing discussions regarding prophylactic interventions and regulatory approvals for novel immunizations. Policy formulation benefits from understanding where current knowledge remains incomplete.
en.limitations: The methodology depends entirely on secondary literature aggregation rather than original patient-level investigations. Modern prospective datasets are absent, and the impact of epidermal infections remains poorly quantified.
en.gids_interpretation: This publication situates longstanding academic discourse on streptococcal complications within established evaluation frameworks. It provides background context for preventive initiatives without engaging with active monitoring networks or real-world detection metrics.

zh.research_question: 该文献旨在评估化脓性链球菌感染与急性风湿热及后续心脏病变之间关联的强度。
zh.study_design: 本文采用叙事性综述方法，整合了跨越近两个世纪的历史与现代文献，并借助因果推断标准与循证医学分级工具进行批判性分析。
zh.population_setting: 现有分析涵盖了不同地区与人群的数据，但作者强调目前在高危队列中开展的前瞻性观察仍较为匮乏。
zh.main_findings: 未经处理的感染与急性风湿热发病率上升相关，而抗菌药物使用与该风险下降相关。中等质量证据支持感染至发病的时间顺序及病原体的特异性，同时存在提示感染后自身免疫机制的生物学线索。
zh.public_health_relevance: 夯实该领域的科学基础对于推动相关疫苗审批以及明确公共卫生干预策略具有重要价值。
zh.limitations: 当前知识体系仍存在明显缺口，主要集中在缺乏针对高风险群体的最新纵向数据，以及皮肤感染对该病程的具体贡献度尚未厘清。
zh.gids_interpretation: 该综述系统梳理了长期积累的学术脉络，有助于厘清病原体暴露与临床表型之间的理论联系，可为未来监测框架或政策研讨提供背景支撑。

articles.title: Resurgence of rheumatic fever among Pacific peoples in Aotearoa New Zealand: A 2010–2023 analysis of hospitalisation data with implications for equity policy
articles.journal: Australian and New Zealand Journal of Public Health

related_surveillance.method: high-confidence article geography intersected with GIDS series coverage
high-confidence article geography intersected with GIDS series coverage

en.research_question: The analysis investigates how ethnicity, residential location, and economic disadvantage shape admission rates for acute rheumatic fever and rheumatic heart disease across New Zealand over a thirteen-year period, while evaluating existing prevention strategies.
en.study_design: Researchers conducted a retrospective evaluation of nationwide hospital and mortality records, applying statistical modeling to compare incidence shifts across distinct demographic and temporal segments.
en.population_setting: The dataset encompasses the entire country, with particular emphasis on Indigenous and Pacific communities residing in highly disadvantaged urban zones such as Counties Manukau.
en.main_findings: Hospital admissions were heavily concentrated among marginalized ethnic groups in impoverished neighborhoods. Case counts decreased for one demographic during a designated prevention initiative, whereas another demographic showed no corresponding reduction. Admission rates experienced a brief decline during a period of widespread public health restrictions, followed by a rapid increase by the final year of observation.
en.public_health_relevance: Addressing persistent disparities requires improved monitoring infrastructure and targeted resource allocation to achieve established national health objectives.
en.limitations: The exclusive reliance on hospital admission records limits capture of community-managed cases, while variable reporting standards and fragmented program delivery may influence observed trend accuracy.
en.gids_interpretation: This publication establishes a historical baseline regarding disease distribution and policy effectiveness within a defined healthcare jurisdiction, supporting contextual understanding for future observational tracking without suggesting active outbreak detection.

zh.research_question: 本研究旨在评估新西兰急性风湿热与风湿性心脏病的住院分布特征，并考察公共卫生干预措施的实际效果及国家监测体系的不足。
zh.study_design: 研究采用回顾性设计，利用负二项回归模型对2010至2023年间的全国住院与死亡数据进行多时段对比分析。
zh.population_setting: 研究对象涵盖新西兰全体居民，重点聚焦毛利人与太平洋岛民群体，尤其关注社会经济劣势水平较高的地区如曼努考郡。
zh.main_findings: 疾病负担显著集中于高劣势地区的原住民及太平洋裔人群。尽管毛利人病例数在专项预防计划实施后有所下降，但太平洋裔人群未见同等改善。疫情管控期间曾出现短暂就诊量锐减，随后于2023年迅速反弹。
zh.public_health_relevance: 结果凸显建立标准化监测网络与推行公平导向干预策略的紧迫性，以缩小健康差距并达成国家防控目标。
zh.limitations: 作者指出当前存在监测漏洞、报告标准不一以及干预措施落实不均等问题，这些因素限制了数据的完整性与政策评估的准确性。
zh.gids_interpretation: 该文献提供了特定时期内疾病流行趋势的历史背景资料，可为后续数据收集框架的优化提供参考，但不代表实时预警信号。
